The current tipo de medios has an unnecessary plural and monitorear is less natural for this settings prompt; this is grammatical Spanish.
491|de: Wählen Sie mindestens einen zu überwachenden Medientyp aus.
The current um zu überwachen leaves the object of monitoring implicit; this forms a concise and clear settings instruction.
491|fr: Sélectionnez au moins un type de média à surveiller.
The current pour surveiller is incomplete because it lacks an object; this states which media type should be monitored.
491|hi: निगरानी के लिए कम से कम एक मीडिया प्रकार चुनें।
देखने means to look at/watch rather than monitor a category; निगरानी is the appropriate term for this settings action.
491|ar: يُرجى اختيار نوع وسائط واحد على الأقل لمراقبته.
The current Arabic is a noun phrase ('selecting at least one...') without an imperative verb; this forms a clear instruction.
493|de: Der MQTT-Broker hat die Verbindung abgelehnt ({value0}).
weigerte die Verbindung is not idiomatic German for a broker rejecting a connection; this uses the correct verb and compound spelling.
493|ar: The current Arabic begins with و, meaning 'and', without a preceding clause; this gives a complete error sentence.
494|de: Ungültiger Port. Dies ist die Remote-Calibre-GUI des Containers, nicht der Calibre-Content-Server. Versuchen Sie, Port 8081 zuzuordnen.

495|zh-Hans: 导入列表没有返回任何结果，请检查设置。
进口 means importation of goods, while this import list is an application feature; 导入 is the software-import term.
495|zh-Hant: 匯入清單沒有傳回任何結果，請檢查設定。

495|de: Aus der Importliste wurden keine Ergebnisse zurückgegeben. Bitte überprüfen Sie Ihre Einstellungen.

495|ja: インポートリストから結果が返されませんでした。設定を確認してください。
輸入リスト refers to importation of goods; this is the application's software import list, so インポート is appropriate.
495|ko: 가져오기 목록에서 결과가 반환되지 않았습니다. 설정을 확인하세요.

495|vi: Danh sách nhập dữ liệu không trả về kết quả nào. Vui lòng kiểm tra cài đặt.
nhập khẩu means importation of goods; this is an application import list, so nhập dữ liệu is the appropriate term.
496|es: No se pudo conectar a BookLore. Comprueba la URL, las credenciales y los registros.

496|zh-Hans: 无法连接到 BookLore。请检查 URL、凭据和日志。

496|ja: BookLoreに接続できません。URL、認証情報、ログを確認してください。

496|fr: Impossible de se connecter à BookLore. Vérifiez l’URL, les identifiants et les journaux.

496|pt-BR: Não foi possível conectar ao BookLore. Verifique a URL, as credenciais e os logs.

497|zh-Hans: 未配置用户名和密码时，必须提供 API 密钥。

497|zh-Hant: 未設定使用者名稱和密碼時，必須提供 API 金鑰。

497|de: Ein API-Schlüssel ist erforderlich, wenn Benutzername und Passwort nicht konfiguriert sind.

497|pt-BR: A chave de API é obrigatória quando o nome de usuário e a senha não estão configurados.

497|ko: 사용자 이름과 비밀번호가 설정되지 않은 경우 API 키가 필요합니다.

499|es: No es un servidor de contenido de Calibre válido. Consulta https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html.

499|zh-Hans: 这不是有效的 Calibre 内容服务器。请参阅 https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html。

499|hi: यह मान्य Calibre सामग्री सर्वर नहीं है। देखें: https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html

499|de: The current German uses the wrong adjective gender and an ungrammatical noun compound; this fixes the label and preserves the URL.
499|ja: 有効なCalibreコンテンツサーバーではありません。https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.htmlを参照してください。

499|fr: Ce n’est pas un serveur de contenu Calibre valide. Consultez https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html.

499|pt-BR: Não é um servidor de conteúdo Calibre válido. Consulte https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html.

499|ar: هذا ليس خادم محتوى Calibre صالحًا. راجع https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html.

499|vi: Đây không phải là máy chủ nội dung Calibre hợp lệ. Xem https://manual.calibre-ebook.com/server.html.

sourceRationales.450: A validation response reports that the metadata server was unreachable; the embedded value is the underlying exception detail.
sourceRationales.451: ProxyTestService reports an HTTP 407 proxy-authentication failure and asks the user to check the proxy credentials.
sourceRationales.452: MQTT gateway settings require Home Assistant's discovery prefix to be a valid MQTT topic prefix.
sourceRationales.453: The rTorrent client version validation reports the minimum supported version and the server-reported version.
sourceRationales.454: PathExistsValidator reports that the configured filesystem path is missing; the placeholder is the path.
sourceRationales.455: qBittorrent's warning explains that its configured Share Ratio limit will remove torrents when reached.
sourceRationales.456: Metadata profile validation lists the exact allowed type enum values: General, Audiobook, and Ebook.
sourceRationales.457: Manual import validation says the selected foreign-language edition does not belong to the selected book; placeholders are edition title/ID and book ID.
sourceRationales.458: Ntfy access-token validation reports a token-format/authentication error.
sourceRationales.459: Root-folder API validation names the dynamic media label and the accepted MonitorNewItems enum values.
sourceRationales.460: FileExistsValidator reports that a configured file is missing; the placeholder is the filesystem path.
sourceRationales.461: qBittorrent reports an unrecognized download-state value.
sourceRationales.462: Goodreads bookshelf settings require a numeric user ID or a profile URL containing that ID.
sourceRationales.463: Transmission client validation reports a minimum supported version of 2.40.
sourceRationales.464: Deluge validation instructs the user to verify SSL settings after a connection/SSL problem.
sourceRationales.465: qBittorrent reports that the selected download category is unsupported.
sourceRationales.466: Deluge reports that its Label plugin is not activated.
sourceRationales.467: Import-list validation reports a missing default quality profile for a selected root folder and media type.
sourceRationales.468: Book API pagination validation requires the requested page size to be between 1 and 1000.
sourceRationales.469: qBittorrent reports that it cannot resolve a magnet link while DHT is disabled.
sourceRationales.470: Calibre content-server validation reports the numeric status code returned for a Calibre API request.
sourceRationales.471: AudiobookShelf settings validation requires a host value.
sourceRationales.472: Notification providers return this shared message when sending a test notification fails.
sourceRationales.473: MyAnonaMouse reports a failed connection test and interpolates the exception message.
sourceRationales.474: The Series API records which preferred narrator was set for a series; placeholders are narrator and series ID/name.
sourceRationales.475: qBittorrent's import warning names the exact Keep top-level folder and Torrent Content Layout options and explains the folder/layout mismatch.
sourceRationales.476: NZBGet client validation reports that the application could not be reached.
sourceRationales.477: Apprise configuration validation states that stateless URLs cannot carry tags.
sourceRationales.478: qBittorrent reports that a download is stalled because it has no connections.
sourceRationales.479: Series lookup validation requires Hardcover to be enabled and an API token to be present.
sourceRationales.480: Book-add validation says the selected result lacks the author's provider ID.
sourceRationales.481: FolderReadableValidator reports an inaccessible folder and a permissions-check error; the placeholder is the folder path.
sourceRationales.482: Deluge reports a refused connection while testing its host.
sourceRationales.483: The Series API reports that a series variant was successfully deleted; the placeholder is its identifier.
sourceRationales.484: ProviderIdValidator says the provider ID must use one of the displayed prefixes and contain an alphanumeric identifier.
sourceRationales.485: Manual import reports that the selected edition identifier could not be found.
sourceRationales.486: Author and book validation requires at least one selected quality profile.
sourceRationales.487: Quality item validation requires every group to have a distinct ID.
sourceRationales.488: Book-add validation reports that no edition of the requested media type survived metadata-profile filtering.
sourceRationales.489: Grimmory authentication validation asks the user to check the username and password.
sourceRationales.490: Book-edition validation requires a specified edition's provider to match the book's provider.
sourceRationales.491: Import-list settings require selection of at least one media type for monitoring.
sourceRationales.492: Conversion settings reject an unsupported audiobook channel mode.
sourceRationales.493: MQTT connection validation reports the broker's rejection result code.
sourceRationales.494: CalibreProxy distinguishes the remote container Calibre GUI from the Calibre content server and suggests mapping port 8081.
sourceRationales.495: ImportListBase reports that the configured application import list returned no results and asks the user to check settings.
sourceRationales.496: BookLore connection validation asks the user to check its URL, credentials, and logs.
sourceRationales.497: SABnzbd settings require an API key unless username/password authentication is configured.
sourceRationales.498: A catalog message describes a path as the configured recycle-bin folder, but the current validator template uses a different dynamic relationship; caller mapping is unverified.
sourceRationales.499: CalibreProxy reports that the endpoint is not a valid Calibre content server and includes the official manual URL.
